titulo.alumno: «Ler um aviso de alteração»: reading a notice of change

intro: Read the text and find the change, how long it lasts and who is affected.

texto: Find the change, its validity and the people affected.
Compare the literal information with the purpose of the text; don't add details that don't appear.
